The '''Repulsor Trip''' was a detection device produced by [[Zone Supplies, Ltd.]]. It was used to detect [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|Repulsorcraft]] through the anti-gravity [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] effect. The trip found common use among [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] occupation forces, who often impounded all civilian vehicles. Any repulsorcraft detected was therefore assumed to be [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] and destroyed.
